nd933026963.headline: Bank: why NSIA is not panicking despite disappointing results
nd933026963.summary: NSIA, a leading bancassurance group in Ivory Coast, is experiencing a slowdown but its founder asserts strengthened governance and defends the company's strategy.
nd933026963.why: NSIA is a key player in West Africa's insurance and banking sectors; its performance signals trends in regional financial services.

n7c93fcc0e1.headline: Hungarian workers received good news: the big wage increase continues
n7c93fcc0e1.summary: In 2018, Hungary's gross average salary rose by 10.4% year-on-year in November, with an 11.5% increase for the January-November period, driven by labor demand and minimum wage hikes.
n7c93fcc0e1.why: Wage growth affects consumer spending, inflation, and competitiveness in Hungary's economy.
